cards.ex: They wouldn't budge on the price, so we had to meet them halfway to close the deal.
cards.exUz: Ular narxda yon bermadilar, shuning uchun bitimni yakunlash uchun biz ularga yarim yo'lda uchrashishimiz kerak edi.
cards.uzDef: Ikki tomonning o'rtasida murosaga kelishish, bir-biriga yon berish.

cards.ex: To sweeten the deal, they threw in free shipping and a two-year warranty.
cards.exUz: Bitimni yaxshilash uchun ular bepul yetkazib berish va ikki yillik kafolatni qo'shdilar.
cards.uzDef: Bitimni yanada jozibali qilish uchun qo'shimcha narsalar taklif qilish.

cards.ex: I draw a line at lying; I won't tolerate dishonesty.
cards.exUz: Men yolg'on gapirishda chiziq tortaman; men halolliksizlikka toqat qilmayman.
cards.uzDef: Qabul qilib bo'lmaydigan chegarani belgilash, ruxsat etilmaydigan narsani aniqlash.

cards.ex: They're playing hardball in these negotiations, so we need to be prepared.
cards.exUz: Ular bu muzokaralarda qattiq kurashmoqdalar, shuning uchun biz tayyor bo'lishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Maqsadga erishish uchun qattiq va murosasiz usullardan foydalanish.

cards.ex: Don't cave in to their demands; stand your ground.
cards.exUz: Ularning talablariga taslim bo'lmang; o'z pozitsiyangizda turing.
cards.uzDef: Bosim ostida o'z pozitsiyasidan voz kechish, taslim bo'lish.

cards.ex: His expertise is a valuable bargaining chip in the negotiations.
cards.exUz: Uning tajribasi muzokaralarda qimmatli savdolashuv vositasidir.
cards.uzDef: Muzokaralarda foydalanish mumkin bo'lgan narsa, ta'sir o'tkazish vositasi.

cards.ex: Let's table this discussion until we have more information.
cards.exUz: Keling, bu muhokamani ko'proq ma'lumotga ega bo'lgunimizcha qoldiramiz.
cards.uzDef: Muhokamani keyinroqqa qoldirish, vaqtincha to'xtatib turish.

cards.ex: We spent all day hammering out the details of the contract.
cards.exUz: Biz butun kunni shartnomaning tafsilotlarini kelishishga sarfladik.
cards.uzDef: Uzoq va qiyin muhokamadan so'ng kelishuvga erishish.

cards.ex: The deal created a win-win situation for both companies involved.
cards.exUz: Bitim ishtirok etgan ikkala kompaniya uchun ham yutuqli vaziyatni yaratdi.
cards.uzDef: Ikki tomon ham foyda ko'radigan vaziyat.

cards.ex: Even though I was nervous, I tried to play it cool during the presentation.
cards.exUz: Men hayajonda bo'lsam ham, taqdimot paytida xotirjam bo'lishga harakat qildim.
cards.uzDef: Vaziyatda xotirjam va befarq bo'lib ko'rinishga harakat qilish.

cards.ex: Always leave room for negotiation; don't give away everything at once.
cards.exUz: Har doim muzokaralar uchun imkoniyat qoldiring; birdaniga hammasini bermang.
cards.uzDef: Muzokaralarda kelishuvga erishish uchun biroz bo'sh joy qoldirish.

cards.ex: He's a tough nut to crack, but I'm confident we can reach an agreement.
cards.exUz: U bilan kelishish qiyin, lekin men kelishuvga erisha olishimizga ishonaman.
cards.uzDef: Kelishish qiyin bo'lgan odam, o'z pozitsiyasida qattiq turadigan inson.

cards.ex: Neither side was willing to back down, so the negotiations stalled.
cards.exUz: Hech bir tomon chekinishni xohlamadi, shuning uchun muzokaralar to'xtab qoldi.
cards.uzDef: O'z pozitsiyasidan voz kechish, chekinish.

cards.ex: They hold all the cards in this situation, so we have little leverage.
cards.exUz: Ular bu vaziyatda ustunlikka ega, shuning uchun bizda kam ta'sir o'tkazish imkoniyati bor.
cards.uzDef: Vaziyatda ustunlikka ega bo'lish, ko'proq ta'sir o'tkaza olish.

cards.ex: I think he's bluffing; let's call his bluff and see what happens.
cards.exUz: Menimcha, u aldamoqda; keling, uning aldami ochamiz va nima bo'lishini ko'ramiz.
cards.uzDef: Birovning yolg'onini fosh qilish, haqiqatni aniqlashga harakat qilish.

cards.ex: All options are on the table, and we're considering everything.
cards.exUz: Barcha variantlar muhokamada va biz hamma narsani ko'rib chiqmoqdamiz.
cards.uzDef: Muhokama qilinayotgan yoki ko'rib chiqilayotgan narsa.

cards.ex: He was able to broker a deal between the two warring factions.
cards.exUz: U ikki urushayotgan guruh o'rtasida bitim tuzishga muvaffaq bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Ikki tomon o'rtasida kelishuvga erishishga yordam berish, vositachilik qilish.

cards.ex: Both sides had to make concessions to reach a final agreement.
cards.exUz: Yakuniy kelishuvga erishish uchun ikkala tomon ham yon berishga majbur bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Muzokaralarda o'z talablaridan voz kechish yoki kamaytirish.

cards.ex: Let's get down to brass tacks and talk about the budget.
cards.exUz: Keling, asosiy masalaga o'taylik va byudjet haqida gaplashaylik.
cards.uzDef: Asosiy va muhim masalalarni muhokama qilishga o'tish.

cards.ex: Negotiation is all about give and take; you can't expect to get everything you want.
cards.exUz: Muzokaralar - bu berish va olish; siz xohlagan hamma narsani olishni kutolmaysiz.
cards.uzDef: Muzokaralarda o'zaro yon berish va talablarni qondirish.

cards.ex: She stood her ground and refused to compromise on her principles.
cards.exUz: U o'z so'zida turdi va o'z tamoyillaridan voz kechishdan bosh tortdi.
cards.uzDef: O'z pozitsiyasini himoya qilish, o'z fikridan qaytmaslik.

cards.ex: We are negotiating in good faith and hope the other side is too.
cards.exUz: Biz halol niyat bilan muzokara olib bormoqdamiz va umid qilamizki, narigi tomon ham shunday.
cards.uzDef: Halol va samimiy niyat bilan harakat qilish.

cards.ex: The negotiations reached a deadlock and both sides refused to budge.
cards.exUz: Muzokaralar tiqilib qoldi va ikkala tomon ham yon berishdan bosh tortdi.
cards.uzDef: Muzokaralarda kelishuvga erisha olmaslik, to'xtab qolish.

cards.ex: If they don't agree to our terms, we're prepared to walk away.
cards.exUz: Agar ular bizning shartlarimizga rozi bo'lmasa, biz voz kechishga tayyormiz.
cards.uzDef: Muzokaralarni davom ettirmaslik, bitimdan voz kechish.

cards.ex: Don't let them sweet talk you into signing the contract; read it carefully.
cards.exUz: Ularning shirin so'zlariga aldanib, shartnomani imzolamang; uni diqqat bilan o'qing.
cards.uzDef: Birovni ishontirish uchun shirin so'zlar ishlatish, maqtovlar bilan aldash.

cards.ex: We need to reach out to the other party and try to restart negotiations.
cards.exUz: Biz boshqa tomon bilan aloqaga chiqishimiz va muzokaralarni qayta boshlashga harakat qilishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Bilan aloqaga kirishish, bog'lanish.

cards.ex: We need to find a middle ground that satisfies both parties.
cards.exUz: Biz ikkala tomonni ham qoniqtiradigan o'rta yo'lni topishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Ikki pozitsiya o'rtasidagi kelishuv, murosaga kelishish nuqtasi.

cards.ex: They pushed back against our proposal, saying it was too expensive.
cards.exUz: Ular bizning taklifimizga qarshilik ko'rsatib, u juda qimmat ekanligini aytishdi.
cards.uzDef: Taklifga yoki g'oyaga qarshilik ko'rsatish, norozilik bildirish.

cards.ex: I tried to get my point across, but they didn't seem to understand.
cards.exUz: Men o'z nuqtai nazarimni tushuntirishga harakat qildim, lekin ular tushunmaganga o'xshaydi.
cards.uzDef: G'oyani yoki nuqtai nazarni tushuntirishga erishish, boshqalarni ishontirish.

cards.ex: We need to iron out the remaining details before we sign the agreement.
cards.exUz: Biz shartnomani imzolashdan oldin qolgan tafsilotlarni hal qilishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Muammolarni hal qilish, tafsilotlarni tartibga solish.
